source.work: Bartolomeo da Mantova / Bartholomaeus Minorita, Liber memoriae artificialis
source.locator: First foliation ff17v–18r; manuscript text ends f17r; f18v and f19r inspected blank. Do not confuse second illustration foliation.
source.thesis: Valentina Cacopardo, Memory and Imagination in the Ars Memorativa in Fifteenth-Century Italy, 2021, printed p136; manuscript ownership and direct-author transcription statement p122 n309.
source.dating: Thesis dates this Vatican witness c1450–60; work/Paris witness c1429. These are scholar dates, not independently verified codicological findings.

visual_observations: Each of the two pages contains ten small bracketed groups of five left-hand line slots, ten associated second-column strings, two larger bracket groups with a third-column string each, and one far-right final string joining those two.

Combined visible topology is 100 first-tier slots, 20 second-tier strings, 4 third-tier strings, 2 final strings. This is a count of displayed entries/slots and joins, not a completed diplomatic transcription of all strings.
First f17v string is visually consistent with Tripecorue; thesis gives TRI PE COR VE from tripode, pepo, corvus, vetula mancina.
The first five-entry group on f17v visibly begins Tri..., Me..., Ma..., Phi..., Ci...; its parent string visibly combines those onsets in order. Full all-node extraction law remains uncollated.
At least one first-tier slot on f17v (second entry in fifth group) is visually very short/unclear. It must not be silently expanded from the presumed pattern.
correction_to_thesis_summary: The thesis sentence 400 words reduced to 20 four-syllable codewords conflates levels or contains an error. The native 100 first-tier slots fit 400 object names compressed four at a time, while 20 is the next displayed grouping level. Secondary strings combine five child strings, not four image names. This is an evidence-based explanation of the count, not a verified correction to every syllable or an assertion of author intention.

finite_source_contrast.flat_model: Each displayed codeword directly summarizes four image names in a single layer.
finite_source_contrast.hierarchical_model: First-tier strings summarize ordered image-name bundles; higher-tier strings summarize ordered groups of previous codewords.
finite_source_contrast.unequal_observation: Native bracket topology and repeated initial-piece construction exist at multiple tiers. A flat twenty-four-syllable-codeword description cannot account for all displayed tiers.
finite_source_contrast.limits: Not a complete proposition/narrative grammar. Recollection requires an already learned image catalogue; compression is lossy without that catalogue. No Voynich word, numeral, image meaning or source identity is assigned.

provenance_limit: Native Vatican images directly viewed by this producer; no modern transcription silently treated as native reading. Only external historical images, no Voynich target images/data/reserves. Images retained in temporary cache, not copied to publication tree.
